Tiny C Compiler 0.9.27 — Fabrice Bellard and contributors; LGPL-2.1-or-later.
Original compiler, DLL, headers and libraries are unmodified. MinGW header notices remain in their original files.
This is a legacy compatibility fixture, not a current production-toolchain recommendation.
Project: https://bellard.org/tcc/
Complete corresponding source is bundled in Aster.html; download it using Win32 Lab > TinyCC source.
It is also available at third-party/tinycc/tcc-0.9.27.tar.bz2 in the repository/hosted distribution.
Original source: https://download-mirror.savannah.gnu.org/releases/tinycc/tcc-0.9.27.tar.bz2



WineMine — source-built Windows GUI fixture
==========================================
Wine 9.0 source revision fd1153552d779e1ac14b0b1c48fbd1cde894eb0a.
Copyright (C) 2000 Joshua Thielen and Wine contributors (see individual files).
Licensed under GNU LGPL 2.1 or later. Aster's original runtime remains MIT.
This is a standalone PE32 build of unchanged main.c, dialog.c and resources,
not the Wine compatibility runtime and not an upstream precompiled release.
Build adaptations: standalone Windows entry point and disabled debug/build
macros. No gameplay or application logic was replaced by JavaScript.
Complete corresponding source, build instructions and license are distributed
in third-party/winemine/winemine-source.zip and via Win32 Lab → WineMine source.
License also at third-party/winemine/COPYING.LIB. Exact upstream blob hashes,
compiler command and binary checksums: third-party/winemine/provenance.json.
The source-built application can be replaced with a user-selected compatible
EXE; it is not required by the runtime. No warranty.
